title: TypeRegistry Mapping File
description: Contract for the JSON document accepted by TypeRegistry.LoadMappingsFromJSON/LoadMappingsFromFile (sdk/go/pluginsdk/type_registry_loader.go). This schema is a mechanism definition only -- finfocus-spec does not ship or maintain any mapping file conforming to it; files conforming to this schema live in plugin repositories or community-maintained data repositories. Not wired into buf/proto generation -- this is a Go-package-internal convention, not a wire contract. One source_format per file.

source_format.description: Case-insensitive match against the SourceFormat proto enum names.

mappings.description: Keyed by source-format resource type string (e.g. a Terraform resource type or CloudFormation logical resource type).

supported.description: Whether the plugin can price this resource type. Matches ResourceTypeMapping.supported.

property_mappings.description: Optional property name overrides: source property name -> Pulumi property name.
